name: West Lindsey

licensing.selective: A selective licensing scheme covered Gainsborough South West ward from 18 July 2016 to 18 July 2021 and has ended. The council has since looked at a new designation for that ward, with Gainsborough North, Hemswell Cliff, Wold View and Market Rasen proposed later; check the council's selective licensing page for whether a new scheme is in force.
licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme found; national mandatory HMO licensing applies (five or more people from two or more households).

housing: West Lindsey is a large rural district north of Lincoln, with Gainsborough its main town. Gainsborough's Victorian terraces near the town centre have a high share of private lets and were the focus of the council's earlier selective licensing scheme. Former RAF housing at Hemswell Cliff and elsewhere is now largely let privately. The villages close to Lincoln have grown with bungalows and modern estates, while the Wolds have older stone and brick homes.
checkinTips: Victorian terraces in Gainsborough: photograph rear yards, damp in back kitchens, older windows and the condition of shared alleys.
Former RAF houses at Hemswell Cliff and Kirton in Lindsey: note heating type, insulation, windows and any shared parking or play areas.
Rural homes off the gas network: record the oil tank or LPG level and any septic tank or soakaway.
Bungalows in the villages north of Lincoln: photograph gardens, garages, driveways and any mobility adaptations.
Riverside homes near the Trent: check for any flood damage, airbricks and watermarks.
Flats over shops in Gainsborough and Market Rasen: note separate entrances, meters and rear access.
tenantHelp: West Lindsey District Council's housing team looks into disrepair and unsafe conditions in private rented homes and licenses HMOs.
